claims.sentence: The purpose of the electronic portfolio is the fixation and storage of information about significant results of professional and personal development of the learner
You independently fill out the following sections of the portfolio

My works and reviews:** This section allows you to present information about any works completed during or outside your studies by filling out the following fields: Title (specify the work title), Type (specify the work type: practice, research work, project, or other work), Description (specify a brief description of your work or research), and File (attach a file with materials, an article, research, etc.)
Evaluation section:** This section allows you to evaluate any participant in educational relations by searching for their work using their email address
Achievements:** This section allows you to provide information about your achievements in academic, research, socially significant, cultural-creative, and sports activities
The evidence does not specify deadlines for completing the portfolio sections
The evidence does not state whether additional sections exist that are managed by staff or generated automatically
The evidence does not define the technical requirements or accepted formats for the File field
The evidence does not explain how the evaluation section processes multiple reviews or handles search conflicts
The evidence does not clarify what qualifies as a significant result for the portfolio's stated purpose
The evidence does not reference any course-specific instructions or alternative submission pathways
